etymologies.etymologyHTML: From type +‎ -ist.

definitions.definition: A person who types, a clerical worker who writes letters, etc., using a typewriter.

quote.citation: 1961 March, “Talking of trains”, in Trains Illustrated, page 131:
quote.text: During that Sunday 42 typists in the Traffic Manager's office at Glasgow were working long hours to produce the staff duty diagrams and new timesheets for the improvised Airdrie-Helensburgh and Coatbridge-Balloch services; ...
